name: RustXNG
uses: Self-hosted SearXNG rewrite that merges provider results as JSON and exposes read-only MCP tools search and read_page with token budgets, robots.txt checks and a refusal of non-public addresses.
features: standard profile of keyless documented endpoints
clean profile limited to local indexes
